items.title: 'Heart ripped out on repeat': Auskick parents say they have been failed by AFL
items.description: The ABC has spoken to several families who say they have been failed by the AFL Integrity Unit following bullying, racism and harassment.

items.title: Leaked data shows NT diphtheria cases surged a month before alert was issued
items.description: Internal Northern Territory Health data leaked to the ABC reveals diphtheria case numbers surged in the NT a month before a public health alert was issued. The data also offers the first public insight into the regions hit hardest by the outbreak.

items.title: 'Notorious' shell company frontman arrested on the Gold Coast
items.description: A Queensland jetski salesman who helped set up offshore shell companies embroiled in scandals involving Mexican drug cartels and North Korean arms dealers faces extradition to the United States on money laundering charges.

items.title: Motel owners say Booking.com has a stranglehold on their businesses
items.description: Booking.com is being sued in Europe, and consumer advocates think Aussie travellers might also have a claim.

items.title: David Szalay was ambushed with an AI sequel to his prize-winning novel
items.description: The Booker Prize winner sat down at the Sydney Writers' Festival to ponder the threat of AI to fiction, share some recommendations and consider whether his book was really about masculinity.

items.title: Teen's extraordinary recovery after surviving 'most extensive' shark bite
items.description: Fourteen-year-old Sam Nai survived a devastating shark attack with a desperate swim for survival, followed by 20 surgeries to reconstruct his abdomen.

items.title: Australians are watching scrutiny of the Bondi attack through a keyhole
items.description: For now, Australians seeking to understand any intelligence gaps, failures, missed warnings and government failings before the Bondi massacre are expected to accept a keyhole view.

items.title: Vivid Sydney drone shows cancelled after technical failure
items.description: All remaining Vivid Sydney drone shows have been cancelled following a technical failure at Monday night's show, where almost 90 drones fell out of the sky.

items.title: 'It's horrendous': Australian diver describes conditions as first cave survivor rescued
items.description: Rescue divers in Laos have safely evacuated the first of five local villagers who had been trapped in a cave for more than a week by floodwaters.

items.title: US judge orders removal of Trump name from Kennedy Center
items.description: US President Donald Trump says his administration will transfer control of the Kennedy Center to Congress, after a judge ordered the removal of his name from the Washington venue and blocked his plans to close it for renovations.

items.title: Trump concludes meeting on potential Iran deal without announcing decision
items.description: The US president has been weighing a tentative agreement that would open the Strait of Hormuz and begin talks on Tehran's nuclear program.

items.title: The simple, ordinary joy of Kylie Minogue
items.description: In the end, a woman who's had wins and losses, terrors and triumphs, and who regularly goes back to stay with family in suburban Melbourne, has become a music legend of her time, and it's not hard to figure out why.

items.title: 'Stop the madness': Olympic stadium fight taken to IOC head office
items.description: Opponents of Brisbane's centrepiece Olympic stadium take their concerns directly to the IOC's headquarters in Switzerland as a critical deadline looms.

items.title: Bondi refuses to answer Trump questions in Epstein probe
items.description: Several survivors of Epstein's abuse gathered outside the Capitol office where the interview was taking place and made their presence known to Pam Bondi as she entered the room.

items.title: We asked for your modern dating love stories — here is what you told us
items.description: From instant connections to immediate rejections to a sudden change of fate, ABC readers take us on an emotional rollercoaster ride with their modern dating experiences.

items.title: How women over 60 are still being made the butt of the joke in film
items.description: Films are four times more likely to feature a talking animal lead than a woman over 60. These charts explain the state of film for older women.

items.title: The nine books our critics couldn't put down in May
items.description: Sweet teen love, gay football stars, alien abductions and a murderous PhD student bent on revenge — this month's best new releases have it all.

items.title: Helping 'big personality' marsupial recover after bushfires left them homeless
items.description: Artificial habitats are giving the Kangaroo Island dunnart a chance at recovery, after bushfires left them largely homeless.

items.title: De Minaur and Djokovic bundled out of French Open leaving draw wide open
items.description: Seeded stars continue to tumble at Roland-Garros as both Alex de Minaur and Novak Djokovic's campaigns end in the third round.

items.title: Big-wave surfing 'pioneer', 43, dies at remote NSW break, doing what he loved
items.description: Tributes mount for Nathan Bartlett, who chased epic waves around the world but died at a rugged spot near Jervis Bay, not far from where he grew up, on Wednesday.

items.title: 'Stand up with us and for us': Artist's passions collide at surf comp
items.description: Surfer Jessi Rebel's journeys with art and identity have beaten similar paths — both inspired by one relative's sage piece of advice.

items.title: Will weapons manufacturing transform WA's coal mining heartland?
items.description: The WA government's proposed defence hub is the latest in a long line of plans for Collie that have delivered mixed results.

items.title: Will Ruth Forrest get an apology for her leaked email?
items.description: The Tasmanian upper house member was livid on Tuesday night after an email she sent to the government was leaked to the media. She wants an apology, but will she get one?

items.title: Why do some people in the Pacific want to make themselves whiter?
items.description: Skin bleaching and lightening products are widely sold in Tonga, which is part of a region with a long history of colourism.

items.title: Tasmanian mum 'grieves' life after unexpected diagnosis
items.description: Experts are predicting Parkinson's disease to double in the next 20 years, but little is known about what causes the condition and how to cure it. Tasmania has been chosen to contribute blood samples to a global study aimed at improving understanding of the genetics behind Parkinson's disease.
